description_en: Retrieves the details of pre-check SQL statements for data import
description_zh: 获取数据导入预检SQL详情
name: ListDataImportSQLPreCheckDetail

parameters.help_en: The ticket ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 工单ID，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
The SQL type. Valid values for common SQL types:
SELECT: query
INSERT: insert
DELETE: delete
CREATE_TABLE: create table

You can choose Security and Specifications > Operation Audit in the top navigation bar to view more SQL types
parameters.help_zh:
SQL类型，常见SQL类型取值说明如下：
SELECT：查询
INSERT：插入
DELETE：删除
CREATE_TABLE：创建表

您可以在顶部菜单栏中，选择安全与规范>操作审计，查看更多SQL类型取值
parameters.name: sql_type

parameters.help_en:
The ticket status. If you do not specify this parameter, all statuses are selected by default. Valid values:
INIT: Initialized.
RUNNING: Running.
SUCCESS: Completed.
TIMEOUT: Timed out and skipped.
FAIL: Failed
parameters.help_zh:
工单状态。若不填，则默认选择所有状态，其他取值如下：
INIT：初始化。
RUNNING：执行中。
SUCCESS：已完成。
TIMEOUT：超时跳过。
FAIL：已失败
parameters.name: status_code

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1
parameters.name: page_numer

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

PreCheckSQLDetailList.description_en: The list of pre-check SQL details

Skip.description_en:
Indicates whether any pre-check SQL statements were skipped. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No
Skip.description_zh:
是否存在跳过预检查SQL的情况。取值如下：
true：存在。
false：不存在

SqlId.description_en: The SQL ID, which indicates the sequence number of the SQL statement. The value starts from 1
SqlId.description_zh: SQL ID，表示是第几个SQL，从1开始

SqlType.description_en: The SQL type. Examples: DELETE, UPDATE, and ALTER_TABLE

StatusCode.description_en:
The ticket status. Valid values:
INIT: Initialized.
RUNNING: Running.
SUCCESS: Completed.
TIMEOUT: Timed out and skipped.
FAIL: Failed
StatusCode.description_zh:
工单状态。取值如下：
INIT：初始化。
RUNNING：执行中。
SUCCESS：已完成。
TIMEOUT：超时跳过。
FAIL：已失败

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the request ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。可用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of SQL statements
